containers.name: probe
command:
const net=require('net');const start=Date.now();let last=start,first=true;const s=net.connect(80,'wsl-varnish.default.svc.cluster.local',()=>s.write('GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: staging.worldsurfleague.com
Authorization: Basic '+Buffer.from(process.env.BASIC_USER+':'+process.env.BASIC_PASSWORD).toString('base64')+'
Connection: keep-alive

'));s.on('data',b=>{last=Date.now();if(first){console.log(JSON.stringify({event:'response',status:b.toString().split('
')[0],afterMs:last-start}));first=false;}});s.on('end',()=>{console.log(JSON.stringify({event:'server_closed',idleMs:Date.now()-last,totalMs:Date.now()-start}));});s.on('error',e=>{console.log(JSON.stringify({error:e.code}));process.exitCode=1;});setTimeout(()=>{if(!s.destroyed){console.log(JSON.stringify({event:'probe_limit',idleMs:Date.now()-last}));s.destroy();}},18000).unref();
